1949, October 23 and 30.
Page 2.
Mr. and Mrs. Alfred Holtz.
P. S. October 30th, (Feast of Christ the King of Kings).
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Holtz:
God bless you again.
I intended to reach you with the above acknowledgement a day or two after its reception but was ashamed to send in so muddled a condition and am disapointed in my failure to have it rewritten.
However you and your little Donald Jay have been on my mind and in my prayers continually since receiving your letter. I am confident You will understand something of what I wanted to write you.
Had I a little more time or if I were a real typest I would run it all over. As it is however, I hope I am not too presumptious if I con- gratulate you on the answer to our combined prayers. I do hope you re- ceive a favorable report tomorrow.
I am hoping, mailing this To-night. Hoping for good results.
Very Sincerely Yours, Pr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Mr. and Mrs. Alfred Holtz 19611 Cherry Hill Lane Southfield, MI. 48076
